description: Use this for any general property tax question that is not about one specific address: "how do I appeal my property tax assessment", "does a deck raise property taxes", "does finishing a basement or a kitchen remodel increase property taxes", how assessments and exemptions work, what evidence wins an appeal. Applies to any US state. Returns sourced answers from Grove Hopper county and state guides and research posts, with links, and points the person to the free check for their own address. Optionally pass a state and county to prefer local guide answers. Do not use when the person gives an address and wants it checked (use check_property_tax_assessment). Read-only.

county.description: County name, if the question is local.

question.description: The property tax question in the user's own words.

state.description: US state name or two-letter code, if the question is local.
